name: American Express Business Gold Rewards Card (Canada)

localized_names.en: American Express Business Gold Rewards Card (Canada)

apr.notes: Charge card: Due in Full balances must be paid each month. Preferred interest rate of 21.99% applies to Flexible Payment Option balances; 30% applies to delinquent Due in Full charges.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident with a Canadian credit file.

base_rate.description: 1X points on everything; plus 10,000 bonus points for each calendar quarter with $20,000 in purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points redeem through Use Points for Purchases (1,000 points = $10 on eligible purchases), travel, gift cards and 1:1 transfers to partner loyalty programs.

signup_bonus.description: 50,000 Membership Rewards points after $7,500 in the first 3 months, plus 20,000 points after $30,000 in the first year.

notes: American Express Canada cards have no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
